{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out rows with -1 in customer_age (missing data)
df_clean = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of customers
mean_age = df_clean['customer_age'].mean()

# Print both the count and the mean to support the claim
print(f'Number of customers with valid age (excluding -1): {len(df_clean)}')
print(f'Mean age of customers (excluding -1 values): {mean_age}')"}
